purpose: Qualify deterministic payment-specific mandate constraints, atomic budget reservation, revocation, fee/FX bounds and delegated-scope non-expansion without defining generic Intent, ActionRequest, QIE or production authority types.

source_register.title: National Payment System Vision 2030+ Consultation Paper
supports: Discusses digital financial agency and machine-led payment activity
Identifies agent identity, relationships and machine-speed transaction volume as policy considerations
does_not_support: A live permission for an AI agent to transact
A final regulatory framework or institution-approved standing mandate

source_register.title: How Agentic AI Will Reshape Payments
supports: Analyses the mismatch between probabilistic agent decisions and deterministic payment infrastructure
Discusses model error, misaligned incentives and correlated automated behaviour
does_not_support: A payment authorization standard
Evidence that a particular agent deployment is safe

source_register.title: Announcing Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)
supports: AP2 proposes cryptographically signed mandates for agentic payment authorization
The announcement describes intent/cart mandates and tamper-evident evidence
does_not_support: Independent assurance of AP2 security
South African provider acceptance or regulatory approval

source_register.title: Google donates Agent Payments Protocol to FIDO Alliance
supports: Google announced AP2 donation to FIDO Alliance
AP2 v0.2 introduces Human Not Present payments under pre-authorized user instructions
does_not_support: Final FIDO standard completion
Automatic production conformance by third-party systems

source_register.title: Agentic AI
supports: FIDO work covers verifiable user instructions, agentic authentication and trusted delegation for commerce

does_not_support: A final interoperable payment mandate standard
Institution acceptance of Mycelix credentials

source_register.title: Secure Payment Confirmation Candidate Recommendation Draft
supports: SPC is designed to provide cryptographic evidence that a user confirmed transaction details
The user agent must communicate payee name/origin, amount/currency and instrument details and collect consent
does_not_support: A standing autonomous payment mandate
A finalized W3C Recommendation or substitute for payment-provider authorization

source_register.title: How Verifiable Intent builds trust in agentic AI commerce

The proposal focuses on tamper-resistant records of user-authorized agent actions
does_not_support: Independent benchmark results for Mycelix
A complete legal remedy or reimbursement model

does_not_support: Open, universal access to the pilot

South African availability

does_not_support: A general-purpose mandate evaluator
